---
title: "Provider index"
description: "Every reserved word — verb, kind, deploy target, step, builder, command — mapped to the plugin candy that serves it."
---

<!-- DO-NOT-EDIT — generated by `charly docs generate`; run `task docs:sync` to regenerate. -->

Every reserved word charly can dispatch, and the plugin candy that serves it. A word's class tells you where it appears: a `verb` in a plan step, a `kind` as an entity's kind key, a `command` as a `charly <word>` subcommand, and so on.


## `agent-runtime`

| Word | Served by |
|---|---|
| `pi` | [plugin-agent-pi](/reference/plugin/plugin-agent-pi/) |
| `tmux` | [plugin-tmux](/reference/plugin/plugin-tmux/) |
